messages:
Sophie C. (CSM): Hey team — Moirai needs a temporary throttle override and IP allowlist for onboarding tomorrow. They want a 48h ramp starting 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC for eu-west.

Ibrahim (NetEng): tagging @Ibrahim to confirm peering/egress changes and whether we can auto-revoke.

Ibrahim (NetEng): Got it. Do we have the exact CIDRs from them?

Marisol (Moirai): Hi all! Staging cluster will come from 34.201.12.0/24 and a single CI runner at 3.120.45.67/32. Window: 2026-04-02T08:00Z -> 2026-04-04T08:00Z. Need +3x qps for eu-west during that time.

Sophie C. (CSM): Plan: ops to add allowlist, infra to bump the rate window to 3x for eu-west for that window, and CS to capture renewal risk. Can infra schedule auto-revoke?

Ibrahim (NetEng): Yes, we support scheduled revoke. I'll open an infra ticket and post the config here. ETA ~2hrs.

Ibrahim (NetEng): infra-ticket #INFR-4921 created. Applying via admin API; config below.
```json
{
  "org": "moirai",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "qps_multiplier": 3,
  "allowlist": ["34.201.12.0/24", "3.120.45.67/32"],
  "start": "2026-04-02T08:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-04-04T08:00:00Z",
  "auto_revoke": true,
  "ticket": "INFR-4921"
}
```

Ethan L. (Solutions): Thanks. Small flag — Moirai is in their end-of-month renewal window. Sophie, can you add a renewal note? They hinted budget constraints and this ramp will inform their commitment.

Sophie C. (CSM): On it. I'll log a renewal risk in CRM and schedule a short optimization session post-ramp. @Ethan can you prepare a cost-by-QPS runbook to share? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Ethan L. (Solutions): Yep — will drop a 2-slide summary with token/QPS cost comparisons by EOD.

ops-bot: Scheduled allowlist addition and rate override for INFR-4921. Change set queued for 2026-04-02T08:00:00Z. Auto-revoke enabled. :white_check_mark:

Marisol (Moirai): Amazing — thanks everyone for the quick turn. We'll run tests during the window and report any errors.

Sophie C. (CSM): If anything breaks, ping #support and I'll join. I'll also set a follow-up check-in on 2026-04-05.

Ibrahim (NetEng): Applied to staging canaries at 2026-04-01T13:05Z for smoke tests. Rolling to control plane in eu-west at scheduled start. CLI log: `apply-config INFR-4921 -> success`.

Sophie C. (CSM): Moving to resolved after infra confirms rollout. Follow-up check scheduled for 2026-04-05. :calendar:
